# Figures

Every kind of figure *hxex* draws: the command that draws it, the files it writes, what it shows, what it needs, and the settings that change it. *Needs* lists the settings that must be set for the figure to be drawn at all; *Drawn* says when the results decide too (a figure of two populations needs a peptide with two). How to read each figure is on the page its name links to.

`hxex figures hxex.toml` says which of them your settings draw, and for each of the others which setting rules it out; with results, it counts the series too. It draws nothing.

`hxex run` draws no figures. File names are given without their extension: `[figures] format` and `[analysis] format` choose it (`pdf`, `png`, or `svg`), and a series' figure in PDF is one file with a page per kind. Parts in braces vary: `{sample}` is a sample's name, `{time}` a time point (`30s`, `5min`), `{series}` a series' label.

## Figures from `hxex report --figures`

Drawn from the results with the settings of `[figures]`; changing them needs no new run, only `hxex report hxex.toml --figures` again. Every one follows `[figures] format` and `dpi`.

| Figure | Files | Shows | Needs | Drawn | Changed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Overview](outputs.md#figures-from-hxex-report---figures) | `overview`, `overview_{page}` | which K was selected and how often, the controls, and the quality flags of the run | [`[figures] overview`](settings.md#figures) true | the controls and quality pages only when the results have controls and flags | — |
| [Spectra of a series](outputs.md#figures-from-hxex-report---figures) | `{series}`, `{series}_spectra`, `{series}_spectra_{page}` | raw data, picked values and the fit of every spectrum of a series, with the picking window shaded, on pages of [figures] page_rows by page_columns (more time points than max_points thinned) | [`[figures] kinds`](settings.md#figures) includes "spectra" | for the series [figures] series chooses ("flagged" by default) | [`[figures] series`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] show`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] residual`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] k`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] corrected`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] page_rows`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] page_columns`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] max_points`](settings.md#figures) |
| [Populations of a series](outputs.md#figures-from-hxex-report---figures) | `{series}`, `{series}_populations`, `{series}_populations_{page}` | each population's mean and share, one panel per spectrum, and the replicates overlaid, on the same pages as the series' spectra | [`[figures] kinds`](settings.md#figures) includes "populations" | for the series [figures] series chooses ("flagged" by default); left out when every spectrum has one population | [`[figures] series`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] k`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] corrected`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] page_rows`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] page_columns`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] max_points`](settings.md#figures) |
| [Uptake of a series](outputs.md#figures-from-hxex-report---figures) | `{series}`, `{series}_uptake` | deuteration against time, a marker per population sized by its share, the controls at the ends of the axis | [`[figures] kinds`](settings.md#figures) includes "uptake" | for the series [figures] series chooses ("flagged" by default) | [`[figures] series`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] x`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] scale`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] k`](settings.md#figures), [`[figures] corrected`](settings.md#figures) |

## Figures from `hxex analyse`

Drawn with the settings of `[analysis]`, into the analysis folder. Every one follows `[analysis] samples` and `times` (which samples and time points are drawn), and `[analysis] format`. Results of fragment series alone give only the fragment figures.

### Fragment ions (MS2/MS3)

Figures of the fragment ions read in MS2 and MS3 scans (the Analysis page shows them in a part of their own).

| Figure | Files | Shows | Needs | Drawn | Changed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Fragment ladder](fragment-residues.md) | `ladder_{parent}_{ion}_z{charge}` | the precursor, then for every ladder step the two fragments and their difference (with its fit when [analysis.fragments] fit_rates is true); a long ladder goes on over pages (_2, _3), the precursor atop each | [`[analysis.fragments]`](settings.md#analysisfragments) not false | always | [`[analysis.fragments]`](settings.md#analysisfragments), [`[analysis.fragments] fit_rates`](settings.md#analysisfragments), [`[analysis] page_size`](settings.md#analysis) |
| [Ladder closure](fragment-residues.md) | `closure_{parent}_{ions}` | the closure miss over time for each split of the parent into an N- and a C-terminal fragment | [`[analysis.fragments]`](settings.md#analysisfragments) not false | where both fragments of a split were measured | [`[analysis.fragments]`](settings.md#analysisfragments) |
| [Residue rates](fragment-residues.md) | `residue_rates_{parent}` | per-residue rates, amplitudes and, with kint, protection, from the fragment ladders | [`[analysis.fragments]`](settings.md#analysisfragments) not false; [`[analysis.fragments] fit_rates`](settings.md#analysisfragments) true (the ladder rate fits, opt-in) | always | [`[analysis.fragments]`](settings.md#analysisfragments), [`[analysis.fragments.exchange]`](settings.md#analysisfragmentsexchange) |
